verses.original: לְדָוִ֡ד אֵלֶ֥יךָ יְ֝הוָ֗ה אֶשָּֽׂא׃ נַפְשִׁ֥י
verses.transliteration: lə·ḏā·wiḏ ’ê·le·ḵā Yah·weh ’eś·śā nap̄·šî
verses.literal: Of David To You O LORD I lift up my soul

verses.original: בְּךָ֣ אֱ‍ֽלֹהַ֗י בָ֭טַחְתִּי אַל־ אֵב֑וֹשָׁה אַל־ אֹיְבַ֣י יַֽעַלְצ֖וּ לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ḵā ’ĕlō·hay ḇā·ṭaḥ·tî ’al- ’ê·ḇō·wō·šāh ’al- ’ō·yə·ḇay ya·‘al·ṣū lî
verses.literal: in You my God I trust Do not let me be put to shame do not let my enemies exult over me

verses.original: גַּ֣ם כָּל־ לֹ֣א קֹ֭וֶיךָ יֵבֹ֑שׁוּ הַבּוֹגְדִ֥ים רֵיקָֽם׃ יֵ֝בֹ֗שׁוּ
verses.transliteration: gam kāl- lō qō·we·ḵā yê·ḇō·šū hab·bō·wḡ·ḏîm rê·qām yê·ḇō·šū
verses.literal: Surely . . . none who wait for You will be put to shame [but] those who engage in treachery without cause will be disgraced

verses.original: הוֹדִיעֵ֑נִי דְּרָכֶ֣יךָ יְ֭הוָה לַמְּדֵֽנִי׃ אֹ֖רְחוֹתֶ֣יךָ
verses.transliteration: hō·w·ḏî·‘ê·nî də·rā·ḵe·ḵā Yah·weh lam·mə·ḏê·nî ’ō·rə·ḥō·w·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: Show me Your ways O LORD teach me Your paths

verses.original: הַדְרִ֘יכֵ֤נִי בַאֲמִתֶּ֨ךָ׀ וְֽלַמְּדֵ֗נִי כִּֽי־ אַ֭תָּה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׁעִ֑י כָּל־ הַיּֽוֹם׃ קִ֝וִּ֗יתִי אוֹתְךָ֥
verses.transliteration: haḏ·rî·ḵê·nî ḇa·’ă·mit·te·ḵā wə·lam·mə·ḏê·nî kî- ’at·tāh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiš·‘î kāl- hay·yō·wm qiw·wî·ṯî ’ō·wṯ·ḵā
verses.literal: Guide me in Your truth and teach me for You are the God of my salvation all day long I wait for You

verses.original: זְכֹר־ יְ֭הוָה רַחֲמֶ֣יךָ וַחֲסָדֶ֑יךָ כִּ֖י הֵֽמָּה׃ מֵעוֹלָ֣ם
verses.transliteration: zə·ḵōr- Yah·weh ra·ḥă·me·ḵā wa·ḥă·sā·ḏe·ḵā kî hêm·māh mê·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: Remember O LORD Your compassion and loving devotion for they [are] from age to age

verses.original: תִּ֫זְכֹּ֥ר אַל־ חַטֹּ֤אות נְעוּרַ֨י׀ וּפְשָׁעַ֗י זְכָר־ לִי־ כְּחַסְדְּךָ֥ אַ֑תָּה לְמַ֖עַן טוּבְךָ֣ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: tiz·kōr ’al- ḥaṭ·ṭō·wṯ nə·‘ū·ray ū·p̄ə·šā·‘ay zə·ḵār- lî- kə·ḥas·də·ḵā ’at·tāh lə·ma·‘an ṭū·ḇə·ḵā Yah·weh
verses.literal: Remember not the sins of my youth nor my rebellious acts remember me according to Your loving devotion . . . because of Your goodness O LORD

verses.original: טוֹב־ וְיָשָׁ֥ר יְהוָ֑ה עַל־ כֵּ֤ן יוֹרֶ֖ה חַטָּאִ֣ים בַּדָּֽרֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ṭō·wḇ- wə·yā·šār Yah·weh ‘al- kên yō·w·reh ḥaṭ·ṭā·’îm bad·dā·reḵ
verses.literal: Good and upright [is] the LORD therefore . . . He shows sinners the way

verses.original: יַדְרֵ֣ךְ עֲ֭נָוִים בַּמִּשְׁפָּ֑ט וִֽילַמֵּ֖ד עֲנָוִ֣ים דַּרְכּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: yaḏ·rêḵ ‘ă·nā·wîm bam·miš·pāṭ wî·lam·mêḏ ‘ă·nā·wîm dar·kōw
verses.literal: He guides the humble in what is right and teaches them His way

verses.original: כָּל־ יְ֭הוָה אָרְח֣וֹת חֶ֣סֶד וֶאֱמֶ֑ת לְנֹצְרֵ֥י בְ֝רִית֗וֹ וְעֵדֹתָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- Yah·weh ’ā·rə·ḥō·wṯ ḥe·seḏ we·’ĕ·meṯ lə·nō·ṣə·rê ḇə·rî·ṯōw wə·‘ê·ḏō·ṯāw
verses.literal: All the LORD’s ways [are] loving and faithful . . . to those who keep His covenant and His decrees

verses.original: לְמַֽעַן־ שִׁמְךָ֥ יְהוָ֑ה וְֽסָלַחְתָּ֥ לַ֝עֲוֺנִ֗י כִּ֣י הֽוּא׃ רַב־
verses.transliteration: lə·ma·‘an- šim·ḵā Yah·weh wə·sā·laḥ·tā la·‘ă·wō·nî kî hū raḇ-
verses.literal: For the sake of Your name O LORD forgive my iniquity for it is great

verses.original: מִי־ זֶ֣ה הָ֭אִישׁ יְרֵ֣א יְהוָ֑ה י֝וֹרֶ֗נּוּ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ יִבְחָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: mî- zeh hā·’îš yə·rê Yah·weh yō·w·ren·nū bə·ḏe·reḵ yiḇ·ḥār
verses.literal: Who . . . is the man who fears the LORD He will instruct him in the path chosen [for him]

verses.original: נַ֭פְשׁוֹ תָּלִ֑ין בְּט֣וֹב וְ֝זַרְע֗וֹ יִ֣ירַשׁ אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: nap̄·šōw tā·lîn bə·ṭō·wḇ wə·zar·‘ōw yî·raš ’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: His soul will dwell in prosperity and his descendants will inherit the land

verses.original: יְ֭הוָה ס֣וֹד לִירֵאָ֑יו לְהוֹדִיעָֽם׃ וּ֝בְרִית֗וֹ
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh sō·wḏ lî·rê·’āw lə·hō·w·ḏî·‘ām ū·ḇə·rî·ṯōw
verses.literal: The LORD confides in those who fear Him and reveals His covenant to them

verses.original: עֵינַ֣י תָּ֭מִיד אֶל־ יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֤י הֽוּא־ יוֹצִ֖יא רַגְלָֽי׃ מֵרֶ֣שֶׁת
verses.transliteration: ‘ê·nay tā·mîḏ ’el- Yah·weh kî hū- yō·w·ṣî raḡ·lāy mê·re·šeṯ
verses.literal: My eyes are always on the LORD for He will free my feet from the mesh

verses.original: פְּנֵה־ אֵלַ֥י וְחָנֵּ֑נִי כִּֽי־ אָֽנִי׃ יָחִ֖יד וְעָנִ֣י
verses.transliteration: pə·nêh- ’ê·lay wə·ḥān·nê·nî kî- ’ā·nî yā·ḥîḏ wə·‘ā·nî
verses.literal: Turn to me and be gracious for I am lonely and afflicted

verses.original: צָר֣וֹת לְבָבִ֣י הִרְחִ֑יבוּ הוֹצִיאֵֽנִי׃ מִ֝מְּצֽוּקוֹתַ֗י
verses.transliteration: ṣā·rō·wṯ lə·ḇā·ḇî hir·ḥî·ḇū hō·w·ṣî·’ê·nî mim·mə·ṣū·qō·w·ṯay
verses.literal: The troubles of my heart increase free me from my distress

verses.original: רְאֵ֣ה עָ֭נְיִי וַעֲמָלִ֑י וְ֝שָׂ֗א לְכָל־ חַטֹּאותָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: rə·’êh ‘ā·nə·yî wa·‘ă·mā·lî wə·śā lə·ḵāl ḥaṭ·ṭō·w·ṯāy
verses.literal: Consider my affliction and trouble and take away all my sins

verses.original: רְאֵֽה־ אוֹיְבַ֥י כִּי־ רָ֑בּוּ וְשִׂנְאַ֖ת חָמָ֣ס שְׂנֵאֽוּנִי׃
verses.transliteration: rə·’êh- ’ō·wy·ḇay kî- rāb·bū wə·śin·’aṯ ḥā·mās śə·nê·’ū·nî
verses.literal: Consider my enemies for they are many and they hate me with vicious hatred

verses.original: שָׁמְרָ֣ה נַ֭פְשִׁי וְהַצִּילֵ֑נִי אַל־ אֵ֝ב֗וֹשׁ כִּֽי־ חָסִ֥יתִי בָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: šā·mə·rāh nap̄·šî wə·haṣ·ṣî·lê·nî ’al- ’ê·ḇō·wōš kî- ḥā·sî·ṯî ḇāḵ
verses.literal: Guard my soul and deliver me let me not be put to shame for I take refuge in You

verses.original: תֹּם־ וָיֹ֥שֶׁר יִצְּר֑וּנִי כִּ֝֗י קִוִּיתִֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: tōm- wā·yō·šer yiṣ·ṣə·rū·nî kî qiw·wî·ṯî·ḵā
verses.literal: May integrity and uprightness preserve me because I wait for You

verses.original: פְּדֵ֣ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֱ֭לֹהִים אֶת־ מִ֝כֹּ֗ל צָֽרוֹתָיו׃
verses.transliteration: pə·ḏêh yiś·rā·’êl ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’eṯ- mik·kōl ṣå̄·rō·ṯå̄w
verses.literal: Redeem Israel O God - from all its distress
